text: 2026年9月10日，中国人民银行副行长宣昌能会见新加坡金融管理局副行长梁新松。双方就当前经济金融形势和中新金融合作等议题进行了交流。
text_en: On September 10, 2026, People's Bank of China Deputy Governor Xuan Changneng met with Monetary Authority of Singapore Deputy Managing Director Leong Sin Soon. The two sides exchanged views on the current economic and financial situation and China-Singapore financial cooperation, among other topics.
